description.value: This independently operated Esso station on Main Street is a key fuel and supplies stop in Lillooet, a remote Interior BC town along the Fraser River corridor. Run by Jai-Pushpa and Chris, it offers a convenience store, diesel, LPG, and an ATM under the Esso brand. For cyclists on the Duffy Lake Road or Gold Rush Trail, it represents one of the few resupply options in a very long stretch of highway.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 18m. Total: 3 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Esso station page on esso.ca confirms an active business at 704 Main St, Lillooet with a matching phone number (250-256-4456) and address, so the listing is real and open. The OSM tag shop=convenience and the feedback form's 'Convenience store' option confirm a convenience store is present; the website lists ATM as a top feature. No specific cyclist amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water, hot food) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those remain null; OSM fuel:lpg=yes refers to vehicle LPG, not camping fuel canisters, so that also stays null.
concerns: OSM name is 'Esso' but the station's own website page identifies it as 'ESSO JAI-PUSHPA & CHRIS'; used the website value as the more specific current name.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible gas station and convenience store in a remote corridor — a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists regardless of confirmed cyclist-specific amenities.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tags fuel:lpg=yes and fuel:diesel=yes. The LPG is vehicle-grade propane and was not counted as camping fuel without further confirmation.

wow_evidence: independently operated Esso station... one of the few resupply options in a very long stretch of highway
